nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical domain type definitions for the entire waggle-os monorepo, declaring 30+ interfaces and type aliases covering User, Team, AgentDef, Task, WaggleMessage, Connector, Memory, Artifact, Command, and Automation entities, plus runtime const-tuple exports (AGENT_RUN_STATES, EXTENSION_TYPES) used to keep Zod schema enums in sync with TypeScript types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses 'as const' tuple pattern (e.g. AGENT_RUN_STATES) so z.enum() in schemas.ts derives the enum from the runtime array, preventing drift between TypeScript types and Zod validators.

nodes.name: schemas.ts
nodes.summary: Zod validation schemas for all API request bodies in the waggle-os platform, exporting 13 schema objects covering team creation, member management, task CRUD, WaggleDance messages, agent and agent-group creation, knowledge graph entities, resources, cron schedules, and job queuing.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives agentStatusEnum from the AGENT_RUN_STATES const tuple in types.ts via z.enum(), ensuring a single source of truth for agent lifecycle state vocabulary across runtime validation and TypeScript types.

nodes.name: schemas.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the shared Zod schemas, covering valid and invalid inputs for team, task, WaggleDance message, agent, and agent-group schemas, including default value verification.
